newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germans allow aide of ex-Afghan president to stay.
newsitem.headline: Germans allow aide of ex-Afghan president to stay.

text.p: An associate of former Afghan president Najibullah was granted political asylum by Germany on Tuesday after a Bavarian court ruled the man's life would be in danger if he were deported.

The court had originally rejected the unidentified man's petition for asylum. But the administrative court in Munich overturned its initial ruling after hearing expert testimony on the conditions in Afghanistan.

The court said that the man, who a court spokesman said was not a member of Najibullah's cabinet, was indeed endangered because of his political views and, if deported, could become the victim of a political attack.
Former president Najibullah, who took refuge in a United Nations office in Kabul after being deposed in 1992, was hanged by the Taleban militia after they seized the Afghan capital last month.
